android.notes: PrintMyTexts 1.7.2: the Back button is fixed - system Back from a phone-messages session now returns to the doors screen. A session with no texts now says so honestly instead of failing silently, and chats locked inside the Messages app still stay locked, in plain words. Same permanent key - installs right over the top.

notes: PrintMyTexts 1.7.2: the transcript reader handles real carrier dumps far more safely now - a text pasted inside another text can no longer swallow real messages or invent ones that were never sent. This is the paired 1.7.2 fix set: the phone-messages session carries the same Back fix as the phone build, returning to the doors screen the way it should. Everything else is the 1.7.1 program, unchanged - same importing, same transcripts, same printing, same update door.
